_comment: GoKollab Community Superengine — onboarding config. TWO LAYERS: (1) community = auto-discovered + coach-confirmed at setup; (2) tierMap/tierRecipes/welcomeCopy = built by the setup interview ('ask the coach'). See CONFIG-SCHEMA.md. All values below are EXAMPLE placeholders; gokollab-setup overwrites them with this community's real discovered values.

community._comment: LAYER 1 — discovered via `groups channels list <loc> <grp>` then confirmed by the coach. ids shown as placeholders.
community._privateChannelsNote: Per-member PRIVATE channels (the '{Name} - 1:1' set) are dynamic — discovered fresh each run for idempotency, not stored here.

purposes._comment: Bind a channel id to each role. Set by the setup interview from the discovered publicChannels.

tierMap._comment: LAYER 2 — GHL tag -> tier key. Coach states which tag identifies each tier. Example placeholders below.

tierRecipes._comment: LAYER 2 — what each tier gets. Coach defines via interview. Two example tiers shown.

welcomeCopy._comment: LAYER 2 — set by interview. mode = 'rotating_scripts' OR 'framework'.
